model_only.development_scope: new environment-only 20-family cohort disjoint from primary40/T1R20/T2

minimal_scientific_drift_rationale: When both feasibility recoveries work, preserving the original model/runtime while changing exactly the diagnosed source-binding representation produces the cleaner causal lineage and leaves a model-family change available as independent later generalization.
purpose: Prospectively resolve prompt-only versus model-only expressivity recovery without outcome-dependent cherry-picking.

resolution_rule.prompt_FAIL__model_FAIL: Kill both local recoveries. Return to source-site/mechanism redesign; do not weaken thresholds or search templates post hoc.
resolution_rule.prompt_PASS__model_PASS: Advance prompt-only Qwen2.5 as primary by predeclared minimal-scientific-drift principle; retain Qwen3 only for later cross-model robustness. Do not choose by competence magnitude or downstream effect.

shared_guards: Both branches are competence-only feasibility diagnostics, never T1 evidence.
Do not lower +0.10/-0.10 source-competence margins or min12/20 cohort gate.
No ACTIVE/control causal-effect testing during feasibility recovery.
No original confirmation 20..39, valid_seen, valid_unseen, T1R reserve, or T2 cohort access.
No branch may reuse feasibility observations as confirmatory T1 evidence.
Any advancing branch requires a fresh full T1 preregistration, independent audit, executable readiness gate, and untouched confirmation cohort.
